title: Captions Lite
description:
The Captions Lite app, built by MIRAGE™, is an AI video editor that makes it easy to create talking videos. It’s designed for creators and small businesses—no professional editor or special skills required. 

Use Captions Lite’s editing tools to make your videos ready for social platforms. Create accessible videos fast, with auto-generated captions, dubbing, and subtitles. You can choose from a range of languages to make as many versions as you need. 

CAPTIONS AND DUBBING 
-AI Captions: Automatically generate accurate captions or subtitles in 100+ languages. You can choose specific fonts or colors, too.
-AI Dubbing: Dub your content into 29 languages, with just a tap of a button.

AI EDITING TOOLS 
- AI Eye Contact: Correct your eye contact to adjust the original recording. 
- AI Zoom: Automatically add dynamic zooms that make your video more engaging.
- AI Sounds: Generate relevant sound effects for your videos.

- Template library: Select from an extensive library of trending caption templates and styles.

EXPAND YOUR AUDIENCE
- Create inclusive videos: Adding captions makes your videos accessible to more people. 
- Support for noisy environments: Boost engagement with dynamic closed captions (cc).

WHY CHOOSE CAPTIONS LITE?
Captions Lite offers the easiest way to create and edit talking videos with AI. Start your free trial now.

title: Captions AI - Auto Captions
description:
Struggling with tedious manual captioning? Captune is an easy-to-use and free captions app and AI caption generator that supports major languages worldwide and offers 50+ stunning templates. With industry-leading 99%+ accuracy, our AI technology saves you hours and makes your videos pop!

Whether you're a creator, influencer, or just love sharing videos, Captune instantly generates stunning captions and subtitles that make your content stand out.

Key Features:

✨ AI Auto Captions:
• Auto Captions: Create accurate video subtitles in seconds with our AI speech recognition.
• Perfect Sync: Video captions are perfectly timed with your speech.
• Multi-Language Support: Transcribe videos in multiple languages like Hindi, Spanish, French, Portuguese, and more.
• AI Translation: Instantly translate captions into dozens of languages with our video subtitle translator.
• Lyric Video Maker: Create lyric videos with synchronized captions and subtitles, perfect for music creators and fans.

🎬 Stylish & Customizable Captions:
• 50+ Caption Templates: Access 50+ trending templates and viral lyric styles from top creators.
• Complete Customization: Edit fonts, colors, size, position, animations, and backgrounds.
• Custom Font Upload: Import your own fonts for unique and branded captions.
• AI Highlight & Enlarge: Use AI to highlight keywords with colors or make important words larger for eye-catching video captions.
• Smart Text Control: Easily add line breaks and page breaks for perfectly formatted, easy-to-read subtitles.

✂️ Powerful Built-in Video Editor:
• Trim & Cut: Quickly trim and cut your videos to the perfect length.
• Rich Music Library: Add music from our vast library, upload your own local tracks, or extract audio directly from another video.
• Advanced Text Editing: Customize your text with various colors and dynamic animations.
• HD Export & No Watermark: Export your videos in stunning HD quality with no watermarks.

❤️ Optimized for Social Media:
• Social Preview: Preview your captioned video on social platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels before exporting.
• Optimized HD Export: Export HD videos perfectly formatted for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, X (Twitter), and more.
• Viral Caption Templates: Use pre-made templates to create trending and viral caption styles effortlessly.

📢 Why Choose Captune?
• Superior Accuracy: Achieve 99%+ caption accuracy with our leading caption AI.
• Effortlessly Simple: Intuitive interface designed for everyone—no tech skills needed.
• Lightning-Fast Results: Get perfectly captioned videos in seconds.
• Always Fresh: Regular updates with trending styles and new features.
• Trusted Globally: Join our rapidly expanding community of content creators.

🚀 Exciting Features Coming Soon!
We're constantly working to bring you more powerful tools. Get ready for:
• Live Caption Mode: Real-time captioning during video recording.
• Closed Captioning & SRT Export: Generate and export SRT files for closed captions on any platform.
• Dual Language Display: Show dual-language captions to reach a global audience.
• Smart Text Editing: Easily remove filler words and fix transcription errors.

Download Captune Now and start creating stunning, professional-looking captions that captivate your audience!

Questions or feedback? We're here to help! Reach out anytime: feedback@captune.app

title: Captiono: AI Subtitles
description:
Captiono: AI-Powered Automatic Subtitle Tool

Captiono is a powerful tool for generating automatic video subtitles using artificial intelligence. With Captiono, you can create synchronized subtitles for any language with just a few taps.

Creating subtitles for videos has always been a difficult and time-consuming task. But now, with the Captiono app, you can create subtitles for your videos in less than 20 seconds with a few simple steps and share your videos with subtitles on social media.

Why should all videos have subtitles?
Social Responsibility for the Disabled and Hearing Impaired: By using subtitles for videos, you can fulfill your social responsibility towards the disabled and hearing impaired. Respecting the disabled, having videos with subtitles is becoming a necessity on social media.

Increase Video Views: Many people watch videos in public places. If your video does not have subtitles, people in these places will skip your video, reducing your watch time, and eventually, your posts on various networks like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc., will drop out of the algorithm, causing your page to suffer a drop.
Captiono is developed according to the needs of bloggers on social networks, with the slogan: Customized for Every Blogger's Needs! Everything you need for Instagram Reels or Posts, TikTok, YouTube, and YouTube Shorts is included in this app. Without needing technical knowledge in editing and content creation, you can edit your videos.

Besides creating subtitles, Captiono is also a powerful video editor. It includes all the essential editing tools a blogger and content creator needs.

Captiono also features other AI tools such as noise removal and sound quality enhancement. Using this AI, you can improve your sound quality without buying expensive microphones. Record videos in noisy environments and use this AI capability to enhance your video’s sound and remove noise.

Who should use Captiono?
Bloggers and content creators
Journalists from various networks
Singers for sharing music videos and clips
Educational institutions
Marketing and advertising teams

Key Features of Captiono:
Create subtitles in all living languages
Real-time subtitle translation for all living languages
Very simple and user-friendly interface
AI features such as sound quality enhancement and noise removal
Customized for bloggers' needs without complexity

Captiono is an essential tool for content creation on social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, and more. With its key features, you can easily make your videos more engaging and reach a broader audience.

title: CaptionMate: Call Captions
description:
Calls you can read! Transcribe both sides of your phone conversations with real-time call captions. CaptionMate empowers individuals with hearing loss to make calls with fast, reliable live call captions. Connect your calls directly to your Bluetooth-enabled hearing aids or other assistive listening devices. Caption calls on your smartphone, tablet, and desktop browser with cross-device support.

CaptionMate is certified by the FCC and free for individuals in the United States who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have difficulty hearing phone calls due to hearing loss.

CAPTIONING FEATURES
• Keep your current number – Set up call forwarding and outgoing caller ID to make and receive captioned calls with your current number.
• Transcribe both sides of every call – Read the conversation in real time with accurate live captions.
• Custom Word List – Add custom words like names and specialized terms to improve real-time caption accuracy.
• Picture-in-Picture – Keep captions visible in a floating window while using other apps or browsing the web during a call.
• Read your voicemail – View captions for incoming voicemail messages.
• Access past conversations – Review transcripts from previous calls.
• 150+ languages supported – Caption calls in English, Spanish, Chinese, and more than 150 other languages.
• Cross-device support – Get clear captions on your smartphone, tablet, and desktop browser for maximum flexibility.

TEXT-TO-SPEECH CALLING FEATURES
• AI Refine – Turn short text-to-speech responses into complete sentences with the tap of a button.
• TTS Shortcuts – Create custom prewritten phrases for faster, easier replies during calls.

ACCESSIBILITY FEATURES
• Bluetooth support – Stream call audio directly to compatible Bluetooth-enabled hearing aids and cochlear implants.
• Display customization – Adjust font sizes and colors for a more comfortable reading experience.
• Built for accessibility – Stay independent, productive, and connected on every call with clear captions.

CALL PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
• Live captions are powered by AI technology built to help keep your conversations private and confidential.

Download today to experience clear, confident phone conversations with CaptionMate. 

CaptionMate is intended for individuals with hearing loss and is funded through a federal program that ensures equal access to phone communication.

FEDERAL LAW PROHIBITS ANYONE BUT REGISTERED USERS WITH HEARING LOSS FROM USING INTERNET PROTOCOL (IP) CAPTIONED TELEPHONES WITH THE CAPTIONS TURNED ON. There is a cost for each minute of captions generated, paid from a federally administered fund.

For more information, please visit our website at www.captionmate.com or email us at support@captionmate.com.

More than 8 million people in the US are deaf or hard of hearing. MixCaptions makes your videos accessible to all fans and followers who may be watching on mute.

title: InnoCaption Live Call Captions
description:
Make Every Call Clear and Accessible with InnoCaption!

Struggling to hear phone calls due to hearing loss? Never miss a word with InnoCaption’s call captioning service to live transcribe your call. Whether you prefer AI captions or captions from live stenographers (CART), ensure fast, accurate captions for all your phone conversations.

InnoCaption is a free, federally funded service designed for individuals who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have difficulty hearing phone calls. Stream phone calls directly to your Bluetooth compatible hearing aids or cochlear implants and get real-time, live transcriptions. InnoCaption works seamlessly with devices like Signia, Phonak, Beltone, ReSound, MED-EL, Oticon, and more*. Missed an important call? Read voicemail transcripts with InnoCaption’s visual voicemail. 

InnoCaption’s call captioning and text to speech technology makes phone calls accessible without needing ASL, offering an alternative to VRS for those who prefer captions. Our caption call app is perfect for seniors, veterans, hearing aid or cochlear implant users, or anyone experiencing hearing loss. Make and receive calls with clear captions using IP relay and teletype technology (TTY) on your phone, tablet, and computer!
Download InnoCaption today—the top solution for captioned calls!

INNOCAPTION FEATURES

Live Transcribe Phone Calls for Individuals With Hearing Loss
• Get clear captions and live transcribe your phone conversations 
• Closed captioning modes: Live stenographer or AI auto captions with teletype technology (TTY)
• Caption call service is available in Spanish, French, Chinese, Vietnamese, and more
• Caption calls on a computer with InnoCaption Web.

Make & Receive Phone Calls With Visual Voicemail and Auto Captions
• FCC certified and funded -  InnoCaption is a FREE caption app for the deaf or individuals with hearing loss
• Setup call forwarding to make and receive calls using your own number
• Stream calls to your Bluetooth compatible hearing aid, cochlear implant, or other assistive listening device
• Sync contacts for convenient dialing & accessibility

Enhanced Accessibility Through Personalization
• Caption Alerts – Receive caption screen alerts when calls resume during long holds.
• Personalize your InnoCaption app - Customize the app to fit your accessibility needs

Hearing aid & cochlear implant compatibility with manufacturers such as:
• Oticon
• Phonak
• Starkey
• MED-EL
• Advanced Bionics
• Cochlear
• Resound
• Unitron
• Signia
• Widex
• Rexton
• and more!*

Voicemail & Transcripts
• Save caption call transcripts to review later
• Visual voicemail converts voicemail to text for convenient review and clear captions to reference

Spam Filter for Secure Calling
• Block high-risk calls and get alerts for potential spam calls

911 Calls
• Caption your emergency calls by dialing 911 from the app**

*Due to potential variations in hardware and software compatibility may vary by individual device.

**911 service may be limited or unavailable in the event of network disruptions or degradation, service connection or internet failure, or other circumstances. For more information visit: https://www.innocaption.com/calling-911

Cellular data plan or Wi-Fi connectivity is required for usage.

FEDERAL LAW PROHIBITS ANYONE BUT REGISTERED USERS WITH HEARING LOSS FROM USING INTERNET PROTOCOL (IP) CAPTIONED TELEPHONES WITH THE CAPTIONS TURNED ON. IP Captioned Telephone Service may use a live operator. The operator generates captions of what the other party to the call says. These captions are then sent to your phone. There is a cost for each minute of captions generated, paid from a federally administered fund.
